markdown:
## DWE
### 0.3.2 Change Log
> **Important:** Use the same DWE 0.3.2 build on the client and server.
#### Global
##### Added
* Added vehicle-pack choices for reinforcements, gun runs, and compatible bombing support.
* Added AshVehicle client compatibility when entering worlds with Superb Warfare.
* Added defensive stops for ground vehicles with damaged tracks or wheels.
* Added switching to usable independent secondary weapons when ground vehicle turrets fail.
* Added NPC crew and passenger evacuation from ground vehicles with failed engines.
* Added B-2 and GBU-57 tactical air support with stabilized attack runs when AshVehicles is installed.
* Added consumable tactical orders with WWII radio and rugged tablet appearances.
* Added server JSON tactics linking bombardment, gun runs, vehicles, and NPC movement.
* Added tactical order editing, linked gimmick editing, appearance selection, limits, and item issuance.
* Added held ground targeting that confirms coordinates and heading when the hold completes.
* Added tactical order consumption on server acceptance and persistent shared cooldowns.
* Added four bundled tactical presets for precision strikes, line bombing, tank reinforcements, and combined support.
* Added per-tactic hold duration, range, and movement permissions, shown in tactical item tooltips.
* Added tactical ground previews, perspective direction guides, and visual and audio acceptance or failure feedback.
* Added horizontal or vertical tactical charge bars with configurable guide and bar colors.
* Added distinct radio and tablet sounds with per-tactic JSON customization.
* Added a tactical gauge rendering API for scripted HUD integrations.
* Added world placement tools for NPCs, vehicle support, fire support, and bombing.
* Added draggable world handles, relative coordinates, and movable virtual centers.
* Added undo and redo for placement, deletion, action timing, ordering, and property edits.
* Added collapsible, resizable editor panels that remember sizes and retain input, focus, and cursor positions.
* Added detached editor cameras with mouse-wheel zoom, adjustable speed, and configured Jump and Sneak elevation controls.
* Added left-drag and middle-drag camera panning in the world editor.
* Added WASD player movement with camera following while the world editor stays open.
* Added second-based event timing with searchable vehicle, aircraft, and payload lists.
* Added timeline zoom, time scrolling, checkbox selection, select-all, and bulk deletion.
* Added pixel effect icons to placement tools, world markers, action lists, and timelines.
* Added compact, clickable world effect icons with hover details.
* Added normal-speed live simulation with temporary NPCs, vehicles, aircraft, and terrain protection.
* Added simulation play and stop controls with automatic cleanup of temporary actors and projectiles.
* Added Ctrl+S saving for gimmick and vehicle editors.
##### Fixed
* Fixed startup crashes when mod loaders cannot enumerate addon classes.
* Fixed blocked vehicle target tag input and text loss when resizing.
* Fixed overlapping gimmick property labels across languages and panel sizes.
* Fixed misplaced help on the gimmick launch screen.
* Fixed aircraft circling above ground targets without lining up attack passes.
* Fixed aircraft losing valid targets during attack maneuvers.
* Fixed bombing runs stalling before alignment or rejecting reachable release trajectories.
##### Changed
* Changed gimmick editing to use world view, removing schematic view and the relocated execution button.
* Changed persistent control instructions to compact hover help.
##### Improved
* Improved Warfare editor selection with a list, details, and contextual source actions.
* Improved editor toolbars with separators between action groups and compact, content-sized action buttons.
* Improved the launch screen with compact document actions and fewer intermediate tool screens.
#### Forge 1.20.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed keyboard crashes in vehicle settings and entry screens.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed compatible DW releases being rejected by a fixed version list.
#### Fabric 1.21.1
##### Added
* Added Fabric 1.21.1 support for vehicle AI, editors, and DNPC crews.
* Added Mod Menu access to vehicle AI settings.
